mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and 60 degrees out at Reddan Soccer Park, accompanied by a waxing crescent moon. If you are an early bird, you can spot the International Space Station starting at 4:47 AM as it travels from the south over Belleville toward the east over Fitchburg.

The Senior Center is seeking volunteers for at least two shifts a month, while the city warns of road work on Highway M starting August 18, which will shift traffic and close the driveway to Alliant and Kwik Trip.

We have plenty going on including UGM at Epic Systems and yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, and look forward to the farmer's market on August 19.
In police news, officers had a notable call on August 6, when a driver was observed speeding and ultimately arrested for a fourth O W I.

Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow, when the flavor changes to Caramel Chocolate Pecan.
